description: Turns outage calls on or off in the project and changes when and for which monitors to call. Pass only the fields you want to change — an omitted field stays as it is. `server_ids` replaces the selection as a whole: to add a monitor to the selected ones, pass the previous ids too. Turning calls on requires a plan with voice calls or purchased calls on the balance (403 otherwise). Phones are switched on per project with `project_channel_set` (`type: phone`); a phone is added and confirmed in the Statuser panel only.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

delay.description: Seconds of downtime before the call: 0 calls right away. Other channels are notified immediately regardless.

is_enabled.description: Call on outages in this project.

server_ids.description: Monitors of this project to call about when `server_scope` is `selected`. Replaces the previous selection.

server_scope.description: `all` — every monitor of the project, including ones added later; `selected` — only `server_ids`.

name: project_voice_calls_update
title: Change outage call settings of a project
